summary: Explains always (runs unless explicitly skipped via --skip-tags always or another of its tags) and never (2.5+, skipped unless requested via --tags never or another of its tags). Fact gathering and role argument validation are tagged always by default.
questions: How do I make a task always run even with --tags?
How do I create a task that only runs when explicitly requested?
Why is fact gathering skipped when I use tags?
Does --skip-tags always skip role argument validation?

answer_card.title: The always and never tags
answer_card.answer_md:
- `always`: the task runs unless you `--skip-tags always` or skip another tag on it.
- `never` (2.5+): the task is skipped unless you `--tags never` or one of its other tags.

```yaml
- debug:
    msg: '{{ showmevar }}'
  tags: [ never, debug ]   # runs only with --tags debug or never
```

Fact gathering is tagged `always`, but can be skipped if the play is tagged and you skip it or omit it from `--tags`. Role argument validation is also `always` and is skipped by `--skip-tags always`.
